rows.observation: There are several meaning shifts (tome-orcs/data/lore/slumbering-caves.lua:24). (1) In 'The others struggled with stiff, fragile limbs...', 'The others' continues the previous sentence and means the other gods; the target renders it 「其他的造物」. reviewers.surface: codex/gpt-6-sol (5 lanes: surface-000 one Cults full-000 of 2; surface-001 four Orcs lanes 20/20/19/19)

notes: Mixed batch (2 Cults, 78 Orcs): surface ran as one Cults full-000 lane of 2 (n<=3 full mode) and four fresh Orcs gpt-6-sol lanes of 20/20/19/19. Every lane echoed its identities exactly and read only its own envelope and the contract. In lane-001-1 three observations slid one entry forward. The host checked each against the frozen source/target: the Dominion-port omission was confirmed on its real revision 38e3195b27, and the Destructicus and Krimbul-letter observations were recorded as additional host observations for re-coverage.
The single contextual run (14 Orcs entries; both Cults entries passed surface) read only its own envelope and the contract. The host scanned its native log before harvest.

Implementation-backed: Plasma Bolt targets a radius-1 ball; Awesome Toss makes each of the two steamguns pick its own random target while the holder is disarmed; the already-known-tinker label marks a learned schematic; Viletooth is a rusted steamsaw.

Supercharge Bullets: the effect grants piercing and armour penetration, not speed, but the talent and effect names are shared (超速子弹 / 子弹掌握：超速), so the rename is recorded for the user as pending item 34 and treated as advisory here.
Mixed batch: 2 Cults and 78 Orcs entries each matched the public DLC source file SHA in the workset; source repositories and commits remain unpinned.
4 confirmed repair revisions raise the window 39 backlog from 0 to 4; below the 20 threshold, so no window opens.
